rulings.question_text: What is the corrected text for OP13-077 Go All the Way to the Top!! per the official OP-13 apology notice?
rulings.ruling_text: Per Bandai official topic notice (October 24, 2025): the revision shall be treated as correct — Before: gains +3000 power during this turn. After: gains +3000 power during this battle. Corrected cards may be distributed at official or authorized events as described on the notice.
rulings.normalized_summary: OP13-077 errata: +3000 power applies during this battle, not this turn.

rulings.question_text: What is the corrected text for OP15-023 Arlong per the official OP15-EB04 apology notice?
rulings.ruling_text: Per Bandai official topic notice (March 13, 2026): Before: Give up to 1 rested DON!! card from its owner's cost area to its owner's Leader or 1 of their Characters. After: Give up to 1 DON!! card from its owner's cost area to its owner’s Leader or 1 of their Characters. Note: the same also applies to alt-art cards.
rulings.normalized_summary: OP15-023 errata: DON!! given may be active or rested; wording corrected on official notice.
rulings.effect_text: Give up to 1 DON!! card from its owner's cost area to its owner’s Leader or 1 of their Characters.

rulings.question_text: What is the official corrected Leader effect text for OP07-097 Vegapunk on the Errata Cards page?
rulings.ruling_text: Official English Errata Cards page (May 16, 2025): corrected [Activate: Main] punctuation and wording — After text applies: rest 1 DON!! then select up to 1 {Egghead} type card with cost 5 or less from hand to play or add face-up to Life.
rulings.normalized_summary: OP07-097: official errata clarifies Activate: Main cost punctuation and Egghead selection text.
rulings.effect_text: This Leader cannot attack.[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may rest 1 of your DON!! cards: Select up to 1 {Egghead} type card with a cost of 5 or less from your hand and play it or add it to the top of your Life cards face-up.

rulings.question_text: What is the official corrected [Main] effect for OP09-058 Special Muggy Ball?
rulings.ruling_text: Official English Errata Cards page (December 13, 2024): opponent chooses 1 of their Characters with cost 6 or less and returns it to the owner's hand (replaces prior return wording).
rulings.normalized_summary: OP09-058: [Main] now opponent chooses target Character to return to hand.
rulings.effect_text: [Main] Your opponent chooses 1 of their Character with a cost of 6 or less and return to the owner's hand.
